name: A Scourgebane strike never triggers another Scourgebane strike, even at a forced 100% chance
contract: Scourgebane 92111: 'Direct damage dealt now has a $520007h% chance to strike an enemy with Scourgebane'. Owner ruling 2026-11-11: the chance applies to weapon hits only and a Scourgebane strike 801832 never triggers Scourgebane again, as the isolated Ascension live logs show (after 1229 isolated melee swings, 263 gave a strike on the swing's target and 1 a second one). Pure Focus 707852 adds its effect 0 amount to the 520007 chance (20 + 10); the fixture sets that amount to 80, so the chance reads 100%. Every landed main-hand swing then gives exactly one strike; a server whose strike re-rolls the chance gives a chain of strikes per swing.
